title: Async/await in one screen
rememberThis: async/await frees the thread during I/O; it does not make CPU work cheaper.
Return Task or ValueTask. Use async void only for event handlers.
Pass CancellationToken through SQS and RabbitMQ consumers; cancellation is cooperative.
ASP.NET Core has no SynchronizationContext; ConfigureAwait(false) still matters in reusable libraries.
bullets: Sequential await is still sequential wall-clock time; start independent work, then await Task.WhenAll.
The compiler rewrites async methods into a state machine that resumes on completion.
ValueTask avoids a Task allocation on the hot synchronous-success path; do not await a ValueTask twice.
await foreach streams pages from IAsyncEnumerable without buffering the whole result.
